pay(address,uint256,bytes32).details: The rebate approximates the true transaction gas cost. Accuracy depends on the      `overheadGas` calibration constant set at deployment: it must account for all gas      consumed after the `gasStart` snapshot (USDC transfer, rebate math, rebate transfer,      event). Use the Foundry calibration test to measure the real value and tune      `overheadGas` so the rebate falls within ±5% of the actual tx fee. An empty merchant      pool causes the payment to succeed with rebate = 0.
